title: Pure Crystron
summary: Crystron cards with the page's generic Extra Deck Tuners and staples. Crystron Halqifibrax is Forbidden; Halqifibrax Prism, the newest card, replaces it. The Crystron main-deck monsters destroy one of your own face-up cards to pull a Crystron Tuner from the Deck, and the Tuners Synchro Summon on the opponent's turn. Prism summons a Synchro Tuner from the Extra Deck, so Crystron Quandax lands early, and banishes itself on their turn for three Tokens. The 2025 cards (Sulfador, Tristaros, Inclusion, Cluster and Eleskeletus) give the deck searches and removal. Most Crystron effects lock you into Machine Synchros, so the Extra Deck is built around them; the page's Cyber Dragon and Therion end boards are left out.
